annotations.title: Ask to turn the live app's emails on or off

description: Asks the founder to turn the LIVE app's outgoing emails and/or its new-sign-in notice on or off. Before go-live, set_email_switches changes it at once. This is a change to how the business runs: your human approves it in their browser with the code Gemmein emails (and, when they set one up, their authenticator app's code). Nothing changes until they approve; approving it carries it out — Gemmein does it the moment they press Approve, once, and records what happened on their Logs. The approval page shows Gemmein's own sentence of the real effect, read against Live; a request that no longer matches Live when it is carried out is refused and nothing changes. Returns the approval link for your human and a handle: live_action_status with wait: true answers the moment it is done, or why not — never ask your human to tell you they approved. A second call asks again (a new approval).

note.description: one sentence for your human, shown under Gemmein's own summary
